issues: [lens-tour-overlay] intercepts pointer events on page load — expanding the [sample-lens-preview-image] <details> summary requires dismissing the tour first. Non-blocking (Skip-tour button exists) but the tour overlay could be scoped/pointer-events:none on non-tour targets.

critical_code_review_comments: LensAiTools.jsx L38 ChildFocusSuggest.accept: object-spread order `{ checked: true, note: '', ...(value[k] || {}) }` will silently unset `checked=true` if value[k] already carries `checked:false`. Currently harmless because the run() filter drops any key already checked, but the ordering is fragile. Prefer `{ ...(value[k] || {}), checked: true }`.

FoundationEditor.jsx blame-nudge: clicking [foundation-blame-save-anyway-btn] correctly persists but the nudge banner stays visible until the concerns text changes. Consider clearing the blame state in the save-anyway handler for cleaner UX.

SampleLegalLensReport.jsx: the auto-starting [lens-tour-overlay] blocks all page clicks on first visit (visible in Playwright timeout). Consider `pointer-events-none` on the backdrop or lazy-start of the tour after the first user action.

success_rate.backend: 100% (3/3 court-triage pytest; 7/7 existing test_iter66_ai_integrations already green)

(8) [foundation-attach-input].set_input_files(small.pdf) → [foundation-attachment-<id>] row; remove works. (9) /auth?mode=register → click [account-type-professional] → [zip-input] must be visible. rca of the issue: No blocking issues. Two minor UX / code-quality items above (blame nudge not auto-clearing on save-anyway, ChildFocusSuggest.accept spread order) and one design nit (lens-tour-overlay pointer-events blocks the sample page).
